decision.explanation: Document D2 explicitly states Albignac is associated with the 'canton of Midi Corrézien' based on official French administrative sources (INSEE, Ministry of Interior). Document D1 contains a narrative where the mayor and baker discuss Albignac being part of the 'canton of Bapaume'. Both documents positively assign an electoral district to Albignac. Per instructions to preserve distinct valid referents and not collapse multi-answer questions, both are retained as they represent distinct assertions found in the source text.
